### Changed
- **The pre-pull fetches the storage-initializer before the runtime image on a new GPU node** (giantswarm/agent-platform#807). `modelServing.prepull.images` defaults to `gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/storage-initializer:v0.21.0`, then `gsoci.azurecr.io/giantswarm/llm-d-fast/llm-d-cuda:v0.8.0`, in both charts. The predictor's storage-initializer downloads the weights, so its pull is on the critical path. Beside the 6.6 GB runtime pull its 96 MB took 72–86 s on a g6.xlarge or g6.2xlarge and 46–62 s on larger sizes, alone 5–12 s. The pre-pull's init containers run in order, so the small image now lands first and the kubelet de-duplicates the predictor's pull of the same reference; the runtime image still lands while the weights download. An installation that overrides `prepull.images` adds the storage-initializer ahead of its runtime reference to get the same start. `make verify-serving-slice` holds the reference to the KServe version of the `kserve-llmisvc-resources` line (0.7.x is v0.21.0) and the runtime image second.
